notes: No build, no dependencies, no backend: a fresh worktree needs no setup. The app is one page; its sections (Home, Learn, Review, Speak, Real life) are tabs in the bottom bar, not URLs; listening practice opens from the Learn tab. Progress lives in the browser's localStorage under the key nihongo.v1, so a browser test starts from an empty profile. The service worker registers only over https, so it never runs on localhost. Audio is the browser's Japanese speech voice: a headless browser usually has none, which the app handles (no sound, a hint in Settings). CI is the Pages workflow (.github/workflows/pages.yml): it runs this same check on every PR and on main before deploying.
